lede: Five steps, one settlement rail. See what you are buying, open Bankr, check the amount and the network, pay on Base, then unlock the corridor route intelligence and keep the receipt.
settle_local_note: The local-currency figure is an indicative FX reference only. Payment is always 5.00 USDC on Base. There is no card rail, no bank transfer and no local-currency payment rail.
currency_warn: Indicative FX only. You are charged 5.00 USDC on Base, never an amount in your local currency.
steps_intro: Every step below settles in 5.00 USDC on Base. This page never charges your local currency.
step1_b: One run of corridor route intelligence: the NSR summer window, the Korea Panstar lane waypoints and the CNY/KRW/RUB FX block. The atlas and the GeoJSON layers stay free.
step2_b: @bankrbot handles the payment. Open Bankr from the button below, or send from any wallet that holds USDC on Base.
step3_t: 3 · Check the amount and the network
step3_b: Before you confirm: the amount must read exactly 5.00 USDC and the network must read Base (chainId 8453). Do not confirm an amount shown in your local currency.
step4_t: 4 · Send 5.00 USDC and attach the header
step4_b: Send 5.00 USDC on Base to the payTo address, then attach the request header shown below. That header is what unlocks the payload for scripts and for this page.
step5_t: 5 · Unlock the payload and keep the receipt
step5_b: Press unlock. The route-intelligence payload is released, and a receipt appears here with the amount, the network, the payTo address and the transaction hash.
header_note: The shape is x402:<payTo>:<amount>. This page sends it for you when you press unlock. Agents can post it straight to /api/x402/fulfill.
unlock_hint: Releases the corridor payload and shows the receipt below.
receipt_status_alpha: alpha contract — on-chain settlement proof is not wired yet
err_need_header: The payment header is missing or malformed. It must read exactly x402:<payTo>:5, as shown in the code block in step 4.
err_network: The request did not reach the settlement endpoint. Check the connection and unlock again.
token_warn: The $ATL token is NOT minted yet. There is no contract address to buy and no token sale. Payment today is 5.00 USDC on Base.
footer_tag: ArcticTradeLanes.com · x402 checkout · 5.00 USDC on Base
